Why: when `extensions.worktreeConfig=true`, go-git overlays `.git/config` and `config.worktree` with `config.Merge`, and `Merge` drops `Config.Raw`. This code reads `localCfg.Raw` to detect `gpg.ssh.program`, so a worktree-local 1Password signer can be missed and native SSH signing is attempted anyway.

Suggested fix: read the local raw config from the actual participating files (`.git/config` plus `config.worktree` when enabled) instead of relying on `repo.Storer.Config().Raw`, and add a linked-worktree test.
